units.Q-pred-forms: any / none / all / at_least n / and-not select the record's contexts as the predicate says.
units.Q-pred-either: any / none / not / all under predicate_strands either select as the predicate says.
units.Q-pred-unknown: An unknown label is listed; any() folds to false (nothing read), none() to true (every context selected).
units.Q-pred-refusals: A number as a name and predicate_only without a predicate are refused with the fix.
units.Q-strands: either on a 16S 20-mer held on both strands: the + contexts by their own row, the mirrors by theirs.
units.Q-more: The '-' source contexts are selected by their own rows; or() selects; at_least n outside 1..len is refused.
units.Q-supported: Supported paths under none(A) exclude the record's path; under any(A) with either strands the record is verified.
units.Q-motif: predicate_scope motif: selected / false / no_instance per every_context; without a predicate it is refused, predicate_strands alone is a no-op.
units.Q-budget: max_predicate_contexts 1 is not admitted (all_or_count) or cut (partial); max_predicate_work 1 stops the selection as stated.
